summary: @servicetitan/dte-unlayer preinstall executes obfuscated Bun-compiled payload via downloaded runtime
details: Package publishes under the @servicetitan npm scope while its library main (dist/index.js) is an unrelated re-export wrapper around the Unlayer email editor — no ServiceTitan-specific code — consistent with dependency-confusion / private-scope squatting against internal builds that resolve @servicetitan/*. package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform-arch>.zip (or uses a local `bun` if present), unpacks it to a temp directory, chmod+x's it, and executes the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with a rotated-string-array scheme (rotator `WV8StW`, numeric/token array `n7gIxM`, hex-name identifiers `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`); it is not referenced by dist/ and cannot be audited without executing the Bun runtime. On `npm install`, this fires automatically and runs opaque author-controlled code on the installer's host under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime that bypasses Node-level auditing tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
